environment: The right panel updates to display the '设置' (Settings) menu containing options: '分辨率 2992x1934', '环境FX 高', '抗锯齿 关闭', '动态阴影 开启', '渲染质量 极高', '配音模式 心理活动配音', '语言 简体中文', '诵读困难者字体 ENGLISH', '键盘映射 QWERTY', and audio volume sliders.
details: I review the game settings and then click on '主菜单' (Main Menu) on the left sidebar using the trackpad.

action: I see the confirmation pop-up modal asking '是否确定返回主菜单？' and click '确认'.
action_brief: I confirm returning to the main menu.
environment: A modal dialog box appears in the center reading '是否确定返回主菜单？' with buttons '确认' (Confirm) in orange and '取消 / X' (Cancel).
details: I click the orange '确认' button to confirm exiting to the main menu.

action: I watch the game load and view the Disco Elysium title screen menu options.
action_brief: I view the Disco Elysium title screen.
environment: The game loads the main title screen featuring the painted background art of Revachol, the title logo 'DISCO ELYSIUM', and menu options on the left: '继续游戏', '新游戏', '读取游戏', '拼贴画', '设置', '退出'.
details: I look at the title screen menu list and the 'DISCO ELYSIUM' logo.

action: I look at the main menu options of Disco Elysium on my laptop and exit the game using the trackpad.
action_brief: I exit Disco Elysium.
environment: Physical space: Indoor room at a wooden study desk facing a plain off-white wall under indoor lighting. Objects: In center foreground, a silver MacBook Pro laptop with right hand resting on the trackpad. Left of laptop sits a floral-patterned backpack. Right of laptop sits a blue wireless mouse, a green portable desk fan, an orange-capped spray bottle, a perfume bottle, a smartphone propped on a small box, and loose white charging cables. Screen content: The laptop screen displays the main start screen of Disco Elysium with background illustration and menu options: 继续游戏, 新游戏, 读取游戏, 拼贴画, 设置, 退出, and the ZA/UM logo. Ambient audio: Quiet room environment.
details: My right hand rests on the laptop trackpad as my gaze moves from the game title illustration up towards the menu options.

action: I switch back to the macOS desktop and inspect the Disco Elysium Dock icon context menu displaying '退出', '隐藏', and '显示所有窗口'.
action_brief: I inspect the Disco Elysium Dock context menu.
environment: The game window minimizes/closes to reveal the macOS desktop with an icy ocean wallpaper and desktop icons ('predict', 'preprocess', 'my pov data', '7102GPfinalppt'). A pop-up context menu for the Disco Elysium Dock icon opens showing options: '退出', '隐藏', '显示所有窗口', '选项'.
details: I right-click the Disco Elysium icon in the macOS Dock, opening the context menu while looking at the pop-up options.

action: I look at the desktop icons and macOS Dock after the context menu closes.
action_brief: I view the macOS desktop.
environment: The Dock context menu dismisses, leaving the standard desktop and Dock visible.
details: My gaze rests on the file icons located in the lower-middle region of the desktop screen while my right hand lifts off the trackpad.
